name: AI Creator's Lab
description: Where creativity meets intelligence! From building smart chatbots to designing websites, posters, and storytelling tools, this lab is your space to experiment with the magic of generative AI.

name: GameNova
description: For those who live to play and dream to create! GameNova is all about building games, hosting e-sports tournaments, and turning gaming passion into real experiences.

name: CodeCraft
description: Think. Code. Conquer. CODECRAFT is the arena for competitive programming, hackathons, and problem-solving challenges that sharpen your coding skills.

name: CipherGuard
description: Step into the digital battlefield! CIPHERGUARD trains you in ethical hacking, system security, and CTFs to defend and outsmart cyber threats.

name: BitOps
description: From terminals to cloud, BITOPS is where code comes alive. Explore Linux, scripting, deployment tools, and CI/CD—taking projects from local to live.

name: FieldOps
description: The energy hub of Labyrinth! FIELDOPS organizes matches, leads teams, and represents the department in sports, building team spirit both on and off the ground.

name: CrossCode
description: Breaking barriers between branches! CROSSCODE helps non-CS students dive into tech through events, mentorship, and collaborations—because innovation has no boundaries.

name: The RoundTable
description: Speak smart, think sharp! THE ROUNDTABLE is for debates, discussions, and idea battles where logic, voice, and confidence take center stage.

name: The Aesthetic Lab
description: The vibe-makers of Labyrinth! From media, design, and content to event branding and coordination, this vertical ensures creativity powers every move.

name: Startovate
description: Dream. Build. Lead. STARTOVATE inspires startup culture, innovation talks, and trend-spotting sessions—where business ideas meet tech minds.
